summary: Specifies the lock function for MPLS Transport Profile networks, which lets an operator stop a path carrying client traffic while keeping test and OAM traffic going. It also describes how loopback works, so a node returns what it receives. It updates RFC 6371.

eli5.summary: Before fixing a road, workers close it to normal cars but let test vehicles through. This defines the same idea for network paths, plus a mode where a node sends everything back.

questions: how to take a transport path out of service
